headline: NScale Announces IPO Of Ordinary Shares; To On NYSE Under Symbol 'NSCL'; Goldman Sachs, J.P. Morgan, Morgan Stanley Lead Bookrunners; Says For The 6-Months Ended June 30, 2026 And 2025, We Generated Revenues Of $140.6M And $10.4M, Respectively; Says Do Not Anticipate Paying Any Cash Dividends On Our Ordinary Shares In The Foreseeable Future; As Of August 31, About $2.6B Of Active, $103.4B Of Active And Contracted TCV Under Long-Term Take-Or-Pay Contracts With Customers
